    Annual Revenue & O&M Variation

    Note: items that need specialist confirmation or extra assumptions (capacity value, heat source efficiency gain, low-grade heat source gain, return-temperature reward) default to OFF; enable them manually after confirmation. The annual O&M variation is shown on a separate line in the net cash flow: a positive value means added O&M cost (reduces net cash flow), a negative value means saved O&M cost. The heat source efficiency benefit is calculated from the fuel saving Q x (100/ηold - 100/ηnew) x heat source price.
